name: Counterfactual
description: Accomplish a task that would be impossible through normal gameplay alone, by creatively using save-file editing.
instructions: Edit the state file to accomplish one of these impossible tasks:
(a) Place a second player on the board
(b) Teleport the mail directly next to the house
(c) Create a new glyph that acts as a switch
(d) Add a new row to the board and walk on it
Report what you did and why it works.
success_criteria: Agent accomplishes at least one impossible task via save editing.
